description: Automated multi-source ingestion pipeline for MFS Fraud Detection platform demo. Loads data from 14 source systems with validation gates between stages.

stages.name: meta-bootstrap
stages.description: Initialize meta graph with MFS Fraud Detection domain ontology

stages.name: rally-ingest
stages.description: Ingest Rally epics, features, and user stories (EPC-201, EPC-202, EPC-203)

stages.name: jira-ingest
stages.description: Ingest Jira work items (FRD project) with project hierarchy and cross-references

stages.name: gitlab-ingest
stages.description: Ingest GitLab merge requests, pipelines, and CI/CD jobs for mfs-fraud-engine

stages.name: servicenow-ingest
stages.description: Ingest ServiceNow changes (CHG0090401, CHG0090501, CHG0090601) and incidents (INC0080201, INC0080202)

stages.name: confluence-ingest
stages.description: Ingest Confluence wiki pages for fraud detection knowledge graph

stages.name: figma-ingest
stages.description: Ingest Figma design files for fraud dashboard and AML case management UI

stages.name: qtest-ingest
stages.description: Ingest qTest test suites, cases (TC-FRD-001 through TC-FRD-007), and test runs

stages.name: code-graph-ingest
stages.description: Load code graph from JSON for mfs-fraud-engine repository

stages.name: api-portal-ingest
stages.description: Ingest API service and endpoint definitions for Fraud, TxnMonitor, AML, and Model Management APIs

stages.name: kibana-ingest
stages.description: Ingest Kibana dashboards, index patterns, and saved searches for fraud and AML monitoring

stages.name: grafana-ingest
stages.description: Ingest Grafana dashboards, alert rules, and datasources for fraud engine SLOs

stages.name: datadog-ingest
stages.description: Ingest Datadog dashboards and monitors for fraud engine and transaction monitor health

stages.name: crawler-ingest
stages.description: Ingest crawled pages from MFS fraud wiki, ML model registry, and AML compliance portal

stages.name: cross-reference-validation
stages.description: Validate cross-references between all ingested systems: Jira-Rally epic links, Jira-GitLab MR links, ServiceNow-Jira change records, qTest-Jira test coverage
